== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Parryl [[Cryce]], also known as the [[Green Knight]], is a [[Lichborn]] warrior and the niece of [[Doctor Janbell Cryce]]. Recognized for her natural talent, she was an early selection for combat and is considered the youngest member of the [[Titan Knights]]. Parryl possesses glowing emerald eyes and gray skin, and she is a highly capable combatant who can utilize standard handguns to destroy fortified structures. In battle, she employs a specific [[Combat Art]] to guide her shooting and has operated both a green [[starfighter]] and the Green [[Titan]]. During intense conflicts, she has demonstrated extreme resilience, even remaining unfazed while being cut by a [[force-blade]]. Following significant injuries or combat, she has been placed in specialized [[Aethertech]] stasis pods for recovery.}}
